title: Capcom confirms data breach affecting 11.7 million accounts
description: Capcom has confirmed a data breach impacting its CAPCOM ID membership service, resulting in the exposure of over 11.7 million customer email addresses and associated information. The breach affects a large number of users but specific technical details and the nature of the exposed information beyond email addresses have not been disclosed.
aiSummary: Japanese gaming company Capcom experienced a data breach targeting its CAPCOM ID membership service. The breach compromised more than 11.7 million customer email addresses along with other associated information. No detailed technical information about the breach method or additional data types exposed has been provided. There is no indication of active exploitation or known exploits in the wild related to this incident.
aiImpact: The breach exposed personal information of over 11.7 million users, primarily email addresses and unspecified associated data. This could lead to increased phishing attacks, spam, or other social engineering risks targeting affected users. There is no evidence from the provided data of direct financial loss or compromise of more sensitive data such as passwords or payment information.
